disprovenClaims: BAC BO (da va + co ca kiem) — 'nhanh dotfiles da san sang cho producer tuong lai'. Neu /mnt/dotfiles la ConfigMap/Secret/projected thi kubelet dung layout atomic-writer (..data symlink + thu muc co dau thoi gian), nen find -type f chi thay file duoi '..2026_.../' (lot guard `..` vi segment do KHONG phai `..`, roi chet o allowlist) con moi ten nguoi dung thay deu la symlink nen bi luot -type l gat => CHEP 0 FILE, voi log tro vao 'allowlist' chu khong tro vao kieu volume. Da va: di theo ..data khi no ton tai + mot ca CI dung dung layout do. Do sau khi va: 'phat hien layout atomic-writer', chep 2 file, tu choi 0.

BAC BO (da va + co ca kiem) — 'bat bien PID 1 da duoc dam bao boi exec "$@"'. set -u KHONG bat "$@" rong (bash mien tru $@/$*), nen exec voi 0 tham so khong exec gi ca va script tra 0 => tini thoat => pod Succeeded. Do that: docker run --entrypoint /usr/local/bin/dlp-entrypoint.sh IMG -> rc=0. Bat bien that su dang duoc giu boi mot FILE KHAC (podspec.go khong dat Command/Args) ma script khong nhin thay va khong cong nao khang dinh — cong PID-1 cu dung docker run -d (co CMD) nen khong phu. Da va bang mot dong + mot cong CI goi entrypoint truc tiep (state=running sau 5s).

BAC BO (da va) — dong log 'dockerd da khoi dong nen' khai mot su that ma no khong biet: `&` LUON thanh cong duoi goc nhin shell cha, nen dong do in ra ca khi dockerd chet ngay luc exec. Da va: kill -0 sau mot nhip, va nhanh hong do 20 dong cuoi cua log ra STDERR (truoc do log nam trong file BEN TRONG pod nen kubectl logs khong thay gi — trieu chung la 'pod Running, dashboard xanh, tinh nang chet'). Do bang cach thay dockerd bang script exit 1.

BAC BO (da va) — cong E9 'do dung thu E9 hua'. `2>/dev/null || true` nuot MOI che do hong, va id1 == id2 cung dung khi luot hai KHONG LAM GI. Ban sua reviewer de xuat (docker run -t roi khang dinh exit 0) CUNG BI BAC BO bang phep do: co TTY thi luot hai attach that va chiem terminal toi khi timeout 30s. Thiet ke thay the: luot hai chay NEN co TTY (giong G4, bridge.go dat Tty:true), khang dinh tu ngoai bang list-clients 0 -> 1.

BAC BO (da va) — cong Trivy trong CI. Chinh plan cua chang nay ghi bai hoc 'trivy --exit-code 1 tra 0 sau khi FATAL', roi cong CI lai co dung cau truc do: khong timeout, khong assertion nao khang dinh luot quet DA chay. Da va: ghi ra file + timeout 15m + mot buoc doc bang tong ket.

BAC BO (da va) — 'pod lab luc ranh chi ton ~7.5 MB RSS' trong Dockerfile va README. Dung voi INCLUDE_DOCKER=0, nhung mac dinh la =1 va entrypoint bat dockerd tu luc container START (khong phai luc claim) => do duoc 153 MiB. Chenh ~20x, va no nam trong dung cai hop canh bao duoc viet ra de chong hieu sai.

BAC BO (da va) — 'rm -f truoc cp la du de khong ghi ra ngoai $HOME'. No chi bao ve thanh phan CUOI; mkdir -p va cp van di xuyen qua symlink o moi thanh phan CHA. Hom nay an toan chi vi /root khong co symlink nao — bat bien cua mot FILE KHAC, khong test nao khang dinh. Da va bang khoi quet find $home -maxdepth 3 -type l => tu choi TOAN BO bundle. Do: $HOME/.config -> /etc cho ra 'BI BO QUA TOAN BO'.

BAC BO (da va) — 'hai cong cap da du'. Ca hai chi khang dinh 0 file duoc chep, ma mot cap dat nham thanh 0 cung cho ra 0. Thieu doi chung duong TAI BIEN — ca duy nhat phan biet -gt voi -ge. Da them ca DUNG 50 file -> phai chep 50 (do duoc: 50).

BAC BO (da va) — 'job sandbox-image gac moi digest cua image nay'. Ly do ton tai cua job (bat PR nang version ma quen digest) KHONG phu PWSH_VERSION/PWSH_SHA256: mac dinh INCLUDE_PWSH=0 nen khong luot build nao cham toi. Mot PR nang pwsh se XANH toan bo roi moi do o may nguoi dau tien bat =1. Da them buoc tai .deb + kiem checksum.

BAC BO (da va) — '369 MB' va '379 MB' bi dung lan lon lam phep tru in dam (+430) khong doi chieu duoc. Hai con so dung cho HAI BUILD khac nhau: 369 la ban 1.E-1 goc, 379 la sha-1530c13 dang chay lab (da them sudo ngay 2026-08-11). Da noi ro moc so sanh o ca ba noi thay vi chon mot.

BAC BO (da va) — so do header cua ci.yml. No ve 'dependency-review (chi PR)' — thu ma chinh file do giai thich la DA XOA — va khong liet ke sandbox-image, job dang nam trong needs va nay mang toan bo cong E6/E7/E8/E9.

BAC BO (da va) — 'find 2>/dev/null la vo hai'. No nuot loi that: mot thu muc con khong doc duoc lam file bien mat khong dong log nao — dung lop loi ma luot quet -type l duoc them vao de sua, va trai voi chinh header cua file ('moi loi o nhanh dotfiles deu la canh bao co log'). Da va bang cach gom stderr ra file roi warn.
BAC BO (da va) — dong log tong ket tu mau thuan: 'chep 0 file (5 byte)' vi $total la byte UNG VIEN chu khong phai byte da chep. Nay tach hai con so.
unverifiedClaims: Nhanh dotfiles chua tung chay qua duong nguoi dung that — /mnt/dotfiles chua co producer. Da kiem voi CA HAI kieu volume se gap (thu muc that + layout atomic-writer), nhung do van la tang image chu khong phai tang he thong.
AC 'DinD offline' do tren pod dind-probe dung tay (cung runtimeClass/hostUsers/securityContext voi podspec.go, qua du 8 validation cua VAP), chua do qua warm-pool + gateway.

ARG DOCKER_GPG_SHA256 / PWSH_SHA256 de duoc bang --build-arg. Tinh chat co huu cua ARG (giong OMP_SHA256 tu 1.E-1), khong phai hoi quy cua chang nay — nguoi co quyen build von da thang. Ghi ra de dung doc comment ghim-checksum manh hon thuc te.
missingProof: AC 'khong ghi duoc ngoai $HOME' khong co assertion TRUC TIEP nao kiem thu nam NGOAI $HOME. No duoc suy ra tu ba co che, moi co che co ca kiem rieng — find khong -L (ca symlink .gitconfig), rm -f truoc cp, va khoi tu choi khi $HOME co symlink — nhung ve tong hop thi khong co ca kiem.

Khong co phep do nao cho cold-path claim sau khi image beo len. AC hien chi hoi p95 claim tu pool AM (0.092s, khong cham image); cau 'nguoi thu hai bam Start ngay sau nguoi thu nhat cho bao lau' van chua AC nao hoi — va gio no co them 3.6s dockerd trong do.

tini chay khong `-g` nen dockerd (con cua sleep) khong nhan SIGTERM ma chet bang SIGKILL luc do PID namespace. Pod van terminate dung han nen D16 khong vo, nhung khong co phep do nao khang dinh dockerd shutdown em.
